listing.name: Diable Avionics (TIDAL FORK) v 3.0.1
listing.summary: my own version of diable cause i didnt like some of the changes in other forks changelog:

description:
my own version of diable cause i didnt like some of the changes in other forks 
changelog:
rime m:
medium missiles->composites
base speed from 65->95
flux dissipation 300->350
flux capacity 6000->7000
coanda:
gave it a built in micro missile array
swapped hybrid rear slot to universal
pandemonium:
increased dp cost from 65 to 75
srab heavy emitter:
projectile speed to 550
sfx increased by 0.2
increased damage to 750 
increased projectile hp to 600
grave hmc:
damage to 70
recson v:
200->225 damage
225 flux per shot
refire delay increased  to 2.4s

lazyhorn:
reduced op cost by 2 now is 10
state support beam:
recson s:
reduced op cost to 6

as always credits to tartiflette and flash frozen for original mod
link to download:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/19HmFHq3-5cf-ZxQ81TN_naB2XtHZrjc7/view?usp=sharing
known crashes and bugs are listed here:
https://discord.com/channels/187635036525166592/1507163509224509510/1512099610909347940
